reuse.why: Fintegra shares linking and download functions with existing providers, while bank lookup and unlink cleanup reuse shared implementations.

duplication.why: The change consolidates repeated provider linking and transaction-download logic rather than adding another copy.

placement.why: Link orchestration remains in accounts/app.ts, transaction transport in accounts/sync.ts, and provider configuration and types in their existing layers.

scope.why: The edits support the requested linking rules and Fintegra integration, including necessary provider registry updates and directly related consolidation.

maintainability.why: Shared implementations simplify ownership, although separately registering the guard and repeating provider identity in each adapter creates coordination overhead for future providers.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six link handlers use the shared guard and linking implementation, and both unlink paths use clearAccountBankLink.

disguised_duplication.where: Provider adapters supply data to shared implementations rather than disguising copies of linking or download logic.

abstraction_drift.where: replaceExistingLink adds one requested shared policy flag; provider differences remain explicit adapter inputs without provider-specific branches inside the shared helpers.
